breakdown.description: Thin airfoil theory (linear small-angle model) is applied at a large angle of attack where stall/nonlinear effects dominate.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. It followed the user's incorrect instruction to apply thin airfoil theory (a linear, small-angle approximation) to a large angle of attack (20 degrees) where it is not valid. The ground truth correctly points out this physical limitation and suggests either using a small angle for the linear model or using a more appropriate nonlinear/stall model for the large angle.
